rules.description: Ensures no duplicate records exist for combination of (firm_id, source_id, metric_name, timestamp_obs).
rules.action_on_failure: Reject entire batch; alert pipeline engineer.

rules.description: Enforces valid ISO 8601 formatting and strict inequality: T_obs <= T_pub <= T_avail <= T_ingest <= Now_UTC.
rules.logic: T_obs <= T_pub and T_pub <= T_avail and T_avail <= T_ingest and T_ingest <= current_timestamp_utc()
rules.action_on_failure: Reject offending record; log timestamp discrepancy anomaly.

rules.description: Validates that metric values fall within physically admissible domains.
rules.logic: For DPD: value >= 0; For Overdraft Headroom: 0.0 <= value <= 5.0; For Bank Balance: not null and not NaN and not +/-Inf.

rules.description: Monetary metrics must have valid ISO 4217 currency; must be converted to base currency via point-in-time FX spot.
rules.action_on_failure: Reject conversion if historical point-in-time FX rate unavailable.

rules.description: Flags abnormal gaps in continuous reporting feeds (e.g. daily bank feed missing > 14 consecutive calendar days).
rules.action_on_failure: Mark entity as 'INCOMPLETE_SERIES'; do not use for sudden distress validation.

rules.description: Flags records where T_ingest occurs > 30 days after T_avail as backfills.
rules.logic: if (T_ingest - T_avail) > 30 days then is_backfilled = true
rules.action_on_failure: Disallow backfilled record in backtesting for any T_pred < T_ingest.

rules.description: Validates that firm_id conforms to approved pseudonym regex and matches active key registry.
rules.action_on_failure: Drop record immediately; security alert for unmapped identity.

rules.description: Verifies that reporting frequency does not fluctuate erratically without provider notification.
Monitors population stability index (PSI) and extreme z-score excursions (> 6 sigma) against baseline.
rules.action_on_failure: Escalate to Model Risk Validator for drift review.

rules.description: Verifies SHA-256 hash of source raw payload and confirms active legal license metadata.
rules.action_on_failure: Halt ingestion pipeline; data quarantined until compliance sign-off.
